stem:
Chirag measures four cups of tea.

Cup P reads 42 °C. Cup Q reads 55 °C. Cup R reads 38 °C. Cup S reads 47 °C. Cup S looks darkest.

Which cup is the hottest?

options.text: Cup Q, because 55 °C is the highest reading.
Cup P, because 42 °C is a familiar everyday reading.
Cup R, because a lower reading means hotter tea.
Cup S, because it looks darkest.

teacher.key_rationale: Higher temperature means hotter. Cup Q at 55 °C is hottest.
